messages:
maria: Quick ask — we need a Dedicated capacity sizing pass for the new 65B bring-up (refactor-65b-v1). Target workloads: chat streaming (p99 <= 600ms), batch embed jobs overnight. Regions: us-west1, eu-west1, ap-southeast1. Initial idea: 4 concurrency/GPU for H100, 2 concurrency/GPU for A100, canary 10% traffic. Anyone run region-level kernel/quant tradeoff sims?
ajay: I have some microbench numbers from last week but didn’t split by region. For H100 + q8f16 we saw ~420ms p99 at concurrency=4 on sequence=512 with our fused-attn kernels. On A100 + q8f16 it was ~720ms p99 at same config.
sophia: tagging perf/infra — region network egress and FTL differences will add ~30-60ms on average between us-west1 and ap-southeast1 for streaming. Need to include that in headroom.
chen: important: q4f16 gives ~2.4x throughput improvement vs q8f16 on H100 in our tests but we observed subtle quality drifts on long-context summarization tests. We should plan canary on q8f16 first, then q4f16 for burst capacity if quality checks pass.
kevin: For autoscale headroom, ops wants 25% spare GPUs per pool to handle burst + canary traffic before we spin new nodes. That’s our default; we can reduce to 15% if kernel/quant mixes are stable.
ajay: Putting some numbers here from bench-bot runs (seq=512, tokens_generated=256, batch=1 streaming):
```
H100 | q8f16 | fused-attn | concurrency=4 => p50=120ms p95=280ms p99=420ms | tokens/s per GPU ~7.8k
H100 | q4f16 | fused-attn | concurrency=8 => p50=70ms  p95=120ms p99=180ms | tokens/s per GPU ~18.6k
A100 | q8f16 | fused-attn | concurrency=2 => p50=240ms p95=520ms p99=720ms | tokens/s per GPU ~3.6k
```
sophia: So capacity calc example for us-west1 (expected steady traffic: 800 concurrent chat sessions, 60% streaming/interactive):
- If using H100 + q8f16 + concurrency=4: GPUs_needed = ceil((800 * 0.6) / (4)) = 120 GPUs before headroom. Add 25% headroom => 150 GPUs.
- If we can validate q4f16 for streaming and run concurrency=8: GPUs_needed = ceil((800 * 0.6) / 8) = 60 -> with 25% headroom => 75 GPUs.
chen: Note: those are optimistic — regional latency bumps in ap-southeast1 reduce effective concurrency because requests are paused longer; treat ap-southeast1 p99 target tighter. Consider lower concurrency targets there (H100 concurrency=3).
kevin: ops constraints: minimum pool size for Dedicated nodes in ap-southeast1 is 16 GPUs per availability zone. Autoscale ramp takes ~3 minutes to add nodes. We need a warm buffer for sudden spikes.
maria: For a rollout plan: start with H100+q8f16 pools in each region sized for steady load +25% headroom. Canary 10% with q8f16 and full eval harness (regression + long-context tests). If canary ok, enable q4f16 as spillover mode behind routing policy (route to q4 only when queue depth > X or latency budget allows).
ajay: Also recommend kernel split: use fused-attn for streaming path, and fallback to generic cuBLAS path for batch embedding to reduce kernel maintenance complexity. We saw ~6-10% latency wins for fused-attn in streaming.
sophia: Action items:
- @bench-bot run regional microbench (us-west1, eu-west1, ap-southeast1) for seq=[128,512,1024], quant=[q8f16,q4f16], kernels=[fused-attn,cuBLAS] and post CSV to #eng-ml by EOD tomorrow.
- @chen prepare eval prompt set for long-context summarization, rig with A/B harness for q8 vs q4.
- @kevin ops: draft pool sizing + node AZ constraints and post expected ramp times.
- @maria will document rollout gating rules (p99 thresholds, quality regression thresholds).
ops-bot: Note: Scheduled job created: bench-bot/regional-65b-qmix (runs: 1) — start 2025-11-21T04:00:00Z.
bench-bot: queued -> running on us-west1. Will upload results to share link when done.
kevin: If bench numbers confirm q4f16 quality parity on our evals, I'm ok moving to 15% headroom and enabling q4 as default for burst traffic. For now keep the conservative 25% as default.
sophia: Thanks, landing doc would be great in product-runbook/dedicated/65b-onboard.md once we have bench CSVs.
maria: Great — will wait for bench CSVs then finalize numbers. If bench-bot finishes early ping me. :thumbsup:
